title: Full gate: federation_reference_durability_pending_commit_is_not_visible_or_reloadable failed with 500 (PermissionDenied stat on its own termal.sqlite-wal)
outcome: The test passes deterministically on Windows under gate load. The cause of the 500 is classified with evidence (product, test/runner, or environment), and a confirmed defect is fixed without weakening the test.
acceptance: The original federation-reference publication HTTP 500 is classified using the preserved failure log and a source-traced causal account, explicitly distinguishing a WAL delete-pending or sharing condition from external interference and test-isolation overlap; unavailable historical observations are identified rather than inferred.

A deterministic Windows regression reproduces the confirmed condition before the correction and passes afterward through the production publication path. Publication still honors the existing durability boundary: pending commits remain invisible and non-reloadable until acknowledged, and genuine permission, path-identity and other I/O failures remain fail-closed. The correction adds no retry loop, timeout inflation, ignored or weakened test, storage-floor change, or durability/authority bypass.

Host-recorded focused compile and tests covering the reproducer, the original durability regression and relevant I/O refusal controls pass on the exact proposed input. Independent read-only Codex and Claude reviews of that input have no outstanding in-scope Medium-or-higher finding, and every earlier such finding is fixed and re-reviewed. Integration and landing remain subject to the standing exact-input full-gate and acceptance rules.
